newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 803 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 803 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 803 contracts versus 892 overnight Monday.
There were 25 wheat, 285 corn, 431 soybean, 39 soymeal, three soyoil, seven rice, 10 corn put and three soybean calls traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was steady to 1-1/2 cents lower, corn was 1/4 cent lower to one cent higher and soybeans were two to three cents higher.
